apps/web/src/features/tasks/fresh.tsx.reason: Kept by the owner on 2026-11-18 (T-429, R-28, option b; decision D98). Synchronizes a Tasks page with Next's own back/forward cache, which shows a page read before a follow-up outcome was saved again after Back; the effect records when each page answer first showed and refreshes a held one. Declined: (a) invalidating in the outcome actions reverses ruling D-827 and takes the save from 7 statements back to 14; (c) reading the Tasks list on the client through the read cache rewrites the page. No other hook works: Next.js 16.4 reports no moment when a restored page is showing (D97), and a rule on the location store's permanent popstate listener runs before Next restores the page, so a refresh there refreshes the page being left and running after the restore would need a timer.
